# Token 与编排器路由

常驻禁止（全仓 grep、递归列 worktree、未验收收尾）在 AGENTS.md。这里只放阈值。

> 配套 references（**进入对应场景才读**，不要一次性全读）：
> - `references/plan-contract.md` — 计划审批的 4 段式契约与送审/确认流程细节，写计划或做 plan_review 时读。
> - `references/dual-model-prompts.md` — 双模型（执行/审核）分工 prompt 模板与选型细则，编排器跨模型编排时读。

## Token

1. 命令输出先过滤或分段，禁止大段结果整段回灌。大文件一次 `write` 定稿，小改才 `edit`。
2. 单会话步数尽量控制在一百以内；上下文压力接近窗口 60% 就收尾或新开。
3. 同一会话不中途换模型、不改工具清单，否则整段缓存失效。运行中改 MCP 工具白名单后，当前会话不会重拉 tools/list：新工具报 UNKNOWN_TOOL 或 Connection closed。若刚改过清单，说明需要新开会话，不要在本会话反复重试。
4. 单步 reasoning 超过约 1.5k tokens 即停：反复自我辩论说明缺事实，先查一条命令再决策。cost-meter 会在连续第 2 个纯推理步自动升级为 `[reasoning-watchdog] 已连续 N 步无工具调用`，收到即必须下一步调工具。
5. 截图最后读、一次一张。图片 attachment 打穿 prefix cache，读 1 张后后续 step 全价计费。多图任务把读图放到上下文尾部。

## 重活走编排器

文件检索、构建与测试、账单查询走 `orchestrate`。**执行类一律 `op:"full"`**（构建/跑命令/检索/读大文件/改代码）；`op:"tool"` 只做纯文本加工，**不执行命令**，别用它跑 build/命令/读盘，否则模型只回「我没有执行能力」，活全推回主模型、token 与耗时双爆。宿主只收摘要。网关 `127.0.0.1:3425` 不可用时才可直接做，并在回复里写明「网关 127.0.0.1:3425 不可用」及原因，不得静默降级。

- 先走 `op:"full"`：单文件 >300 行整读、`npm run lint` 全量、`npm run build`、账单/大结果查询。
- `execution:{program,args}` 的 `workdir` 必须是**含 `package.json` 的前端子模块目录**（如 `zhi2-web-admin/`），**不是父仓根**；否则 `orchestrate` 报 `INVALID_EXECUTION`。
- 单文件 ≤300 行、单条窄命令（`npx eslint <file>`）可直接执行。
- 同一工具同一错误最多重试一次，第二次换方案。

## 编码

编码、修复、重构、实现默认先 `orchestrate`。编排器负责检索、方案、代码文本、构建与测试；宿主核对摘要后写入。单行或文案微调可直接改文件。

## 运行时守卫（插件自动执行，不必再靠自觉）

以下由本地插件在工具执行期/每步前自动生效，收到对应提示时**直接照做**，不要争辩：

- `agent-guard`：工具参数形状修复；pwsh POSIX 命令预检（`head`/`tail`/`cat` 自动改写，`grep`/`sed`/`awk`/`wc`/`find` 告警）；glob 绝对路径分隔符规范化；仓库根/容器级 grep·glob 拦截（拒绝时给可直接照抄的 `glob{path,pattern}`/`grep{path,pattern,include}` 模板）；`Get-ChildItem -Recurse` 递归列举拦截；同会话重复整读拦截（提示上次读到的行区间 + 续读 `offset`）；`ask_user_question` 缺 `id` 自动补 `q0/q1`。
- `token-guard`：grep **文件 ≥5 且 命中 ≥30** 才折叠为文件清单+**行号**（组合条件，单文件几十条也回行内容；带 `-C/-A/-B` 上下文时不折叠）；read 未带 `offset/limit` 时：`.vue` >500 行、其余 >300 行门禁不回内容；read >500 行且带 range 时截断兜底。
- `cost-meter`：单步未命中/输出超预算提醒；连续纯推理步（单步 >3000 且无工具）升级为「下一步必须调工具」；连续大未命中升级为「只允许窄读/带 path 的 grep/一条 SQL」白名单；同一 turn 命中的多条检查**合并成一条** user 消息（不逐步刷屏、少打穿 cache）；意图含「修改+验证+提交」时提示先 todo_write；已开始改文件却无构建基线时提示先 build；收尾证据不齐时提示。

<script setup lang="ts">
/**
 * 求援工单列表页 —— C 端物业企业视图（真实 uni-app 页面，标准导航栏 / 标准路由）。
 * 数据层：走真实后端 /v2.0/safety/flood/rescue/*；接口不可用时空列表提示，不使用演示数据。

import { ref } from 'vue'
import { onLoad } from '@dcloudio/uni-app'
import { request, isConfigured } from '../../utils/request'

const LEVEL: Record<number, string> = { 1: '一般', 2: '紧急', 3: '特级' }
const STATUS: Record<string, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  pending: { label: '待受理', cls: 'pending' },
  accepted: { label: '已受理', cls: 'accepted' },
  processing: { label: '救援处置中', cls: 'processing' },
  done: { label: '已完成', cls: 'done' },
}

interface NodeRec { src: string; act: string; time: string; text: string }
interface Order {
  id: string; level: number; status: string; title: string; created: string; reporter: string
  area: string; region: string; street: string; community: string; owner: string; phone: string
  desc: string; need?: string; photos?: string[]; nodes: NodeRec[]
}

const orders = ref<Order[]>([])
const loading = ref(false)

function esc(s: unknown) { return String(s ?? '') }

/* ---------- 接口映射 ---------- */
const URGENT_NUM: Record<string, number> = { '1': 1, '2': 2, '3': 3, '一般': 1, '紧急': 2, '特级': 3 }
function normStatus(raw: unknown): string {
  const v = String(raw ?? '').toLowerCase()
  if (['1', 'accepted', '受理', '已受理'].includes(v)) return 'accepted'
  if (['2', 'processing', '处置中', '救援处置中', 'inprogress'].includes(v)) return 'processing'
  if (['3', 'done', 'completed', '完成', '已完成', 'finish'].includes(v)) return 'done'
  return 'pending'
}
function backStatus(raw: number | string): string {
  if (raw === 0 || raw === '0' || raw === 1 || raw === '1') return 'pending'
  if (raw === 2 || raw === '2') return 'processing'
  if (raw === 3 || raw === '3') return 'done'
  return normStatus(raw)
}
interface RescueApiRow {
  rescueId?: string | number; rescueNo?: string; complexName?: string; regionName?: string
  contactName?: string; contactPhone?: string; urgentLevel?: string; dangerDesc?: string
  supportDesc?: string; attachUrl?: string; status?: string | number; createTime?: string
  title?: string; street?: string; community?: string; logs?: Array<{ src?: string; act?: string; time?: string; text?: string }>
}
function mapRow(r: RescueApiRow): Order {
  const level = URGENT_NUM[String(r.urgentLevel ?? '')] ?? 2
  const area = String(r.complexName || '物业管理区域')
  const desc = String(r.dangerDesc || '')
  return {
    id: String(r.rescueNo || r.rescueId || ''),
    level,
    status: backStatus(r.status ?? 0),
    title: String(r.title || `${area} · ${desc.slice(0, 16)}`),
    created: String(r.createTime || ''),
    reporter: String(r.contactName || '—'),
    area, region: String(r.regionName || ''), street: String(r.street || ''), community: String(r.community || ''),
    owner: String(r.contactName || '—'), phone: String(r.contactPhone || ''),
    desc, need: String(r.supportDesc || ''),
    photos: String(r.attachUrl || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
    nodes: (r.logs || []).map(l => ({ src: String(l.src || '物业企业'), act: String(l.act || '发起求援'), time: String(l.time || ''), text: String(l.text || '') })),
  }
}

async function loadList() {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    if (!isConfigured()) throw new Error('接口未配置')
    const res = await request<{ rows?: RescueApiRow[]; total?: number }>(
      `/v2.0/safety/flood/rescue/page?pageNum=1&pageSize=50`, { raw: true }
    )
    orders.value = (res?.rows ?? []).map(mapRow)
  } catch {
    orders.value = []
  } finally { loading.value = false }
}

/* ---------- 标准路由跳转 ---------- */
function openDetail(id: string) {
  uni.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/rescue-workorder/detail?id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}` })
}
function gotoForm() {
  uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/rescue-workorder/form' })
}

onLoad(loadList)

  if (submitLock) return
  if (!form.contact.trim()) { uni.showToast({ title: '请填写联系人', icon: 'none' }); return }
  if (!/^1\d{10}$/.test(form.phone.replace(/\s/g, ''))) { uni.showToast({ title: '请填写有效的11位联系电话', icon: 'none' }); return }

      urgentLevel: String(form.level), dangerDesc: form.desc.trim(), supportDesc: form.need.trim(),

/**
 * 求援工单详情页 —— 真实 uni-app 页面，标准导航栏。

import { ref } from 'vue'
import { onLoad } from '@dcloudio/uni-app'

import { resolveAssetUrl } from '../../utils/upload'

const LEVEL: Record<number, string> = { 1: '一般', 2: '紧急', 3: '特级' }
const STATUS: Record<string, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  pending: { label: '待受理', cls: 'pending' },
  accepted: { label: '已受理', cls: 'accepted' },
  processing: { label: '救援处置中', cls: 'processing' },
  done: { label: '已完成', cls: 'done' },
}

interface NodeRec { src: string; act: string; time: string; text: string }
interface Order {
  id: string; level: number; status: string; title: string; created: string; reporter: string
  area: string; region: string; street: string; community: string; owner: string; phone: string
  desc: string; need?: string; photos?: string[]; nodes: NodeRec[]
}

const current = ref<Order | null>(null)
const loading = ref(true)
function esc(s: unknown) { return String(s ?? '') }

const URGENT_NUM: Record<string, number> = { '1': 1, '2': 2, '3': 3, '一般': 1, '紧急': 2, '特级': 3 }
function normStatus(raw: unknown): string {
  const v = String(raw ?? '').toLowerCase()
  if (['1', 'accepted', '受理', '已受理'].includes(v)) return 'accepted'
  if (['2', 'processing', '处置中', '救援处置中', 'inprogress'].includes(v)) return 'processing'
  if (['3', 'done', 'completed', '完成', '已完成', 'finish'].includes(v)) return 'done'
  return 'pending'
}
function backStatus(raw: number | string): string {
  if (raw === 0 || raw === '0' || raw === 1 || raw === '1') return 'pending'
  if (raw === 2 || raw === '2') return 'processing'
  if (raw === 3 || raw === '3') return 'done'
  return normStatus(raw)
}
interface RescueApiRow {
  rescueId?: string | number; rescueNo?: string; complexName?: string; regionName?: string
  contactName?: string; contactPhone?: string; urgentLevel?: string; dangerDesc?: string
  supportDesc?: string; attachUrl?: string; status?: string | number; createTime?: string
  title?: string; street?: string; community?: string; logs?: Array<{ src?: string; act?: string; time?: string; text?: string }>
}
function mapRow(r: RescueApiRow): Order {
  const level = URGENT_NUM[String(r.urgentLevel ?? '')] ?? 2
  const area = String(r.complexName || '物业管理区域')
  return {
    id: String(r.rescueNo || r.rescueId || ''),
    level, status: backStatus(r.status ?? 0),
    title: String(r.title || area),
    created: String(r.createTime || ''),
    reporter: String(r.contactName || '—'),
    area, region: String(r.regionName || ''), street: String(r.street || ''), community: String(r.community || ''),
    owner: String(r.contactName || '—'), phone: String(r.contactPhone || ''),
    desc: String(r.dangerDesc || ''), need: String(r.supportDesc || ''),
    photos: String(r.attachUrl || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
    nodes: (r.logs || []).map(l => ({ src: String(l.src || '物业企业'), act: String(l.act || '发起求援'), time: String(l.time || ''), text: String(l.text || '') })),
  }
}

async function loadDetail(id: string) {
  loading.value = true
  try {
    if (!isConfigured()) throw new Error('接口未配置')
    const r = await request<RescueApiRow>(`/v2.0/safety/flood/rescue/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { raw: true })
    current.value = mapRow(r)
  } catch {
    current.value = null
  } finally { loading.value = false }
}

function preview(url: string) {
  const all = current.value?.photos ?? []
  uni.previewImage({ current: resolveAssetUrl(url), urls: all.map(resolveAssetUrl) })
}
function callPhone(phone: string) {
  if (!phone) return
  uni.makePhoneCall({ phoneNumber: phone, fail: () => {} })
}

onLoad(options => { loadDetail(String(options?.id ?? '')) })
</script>

This guide covers the loop and the common web tasks. ## Always use your own session

Before your first command, get a session name for the task. It is stable for the worktree, so running it again prints the same name:

```bash
agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task   # prints a name such as task-be5442ae6b6b
```
